slug: 说好武侠世界你怎么教人修仙
lines: 南荒界。
在大陆的边缘地带，万山交叠，山脉围锁，重重山峦將一整个世界彻底围困其中。
好似一座孤岛，悬立於世。
正因如此，此方世界得名南荒界。
世人不知南荒天外还否有天，也从未有人穿过这重重山峦的包围，去到过山外的世界。
对於南荒界人来说，这十万大山以內的广袤世界，便是唯一天地。
南荒界横跨十万里的疆土之內，共有五大皇朝屹立。
这五大皇朝共同统治著南荒世界，是此方世界的唯一主人，对界內生灵，有著生杀予夺的绝对权利。
如五座大山，死死的悬在世人的头顶上。
就是后世之人，兴起的势力如何强盛，都未曾动摇过半点五皇朝的统治。
除去五大皇朝这些世俗势力外。
南荒界疆域之中，还林立著诸多武修宗门。
此中无数武修，便是在五大皇朝与诸多宗门构筑的规矩下进行修炼。
武修目前已知的境界从弱至强，一共分为三流，二流，一流后天，先天，宗师，大宗师七大境界，等级森严，难以逾越。
三流武者是五大皇朝最底层的武者，算是与普通百姓一般的底层存在。
大多数的三流武师都只能做鏢师，亦或者捕快等辛苦劳累，受人驱使的差事。
而大宗师，这种站在南荒域武修顶点的武者，则是有所不同。
大宗师不仅受世人崇敬，就是那些王公贵族，宗门长老遇见了都得以礼相待，不惜代价都要將其请入势力，做高高在上的客卿。
虽同为修炼者，其中地位却有若云泥。
“也正因如此，五大皇朝的武修，都拼了命的想要往上挤。”
翻来覆去都是这些內容，楚风看得都有些想吐了。
北离国，江南道，东离城外，有著一片密林。
此处密林，是东离城最为有名的一片林子。
密林占地庞大，环抱东离城而立。
密林外围时常有凶兽徘徊，寻常百姓不敢靠近。
就是那三流武者，都只敢在外层游走，不敢深入其中。
也正因如此，这片林子，已经十多年无人问津，成为了一片类似禁地般的存在了。
而在那人跡罕见的密林深处，却突兀的立著一间茅草屋。
草屋內，青年翘著二郎腿，翻看著房间里为数不多的书册。
楚风合上书本，嘆息一声，自草屋內走出。
左右看了一眼这片翠绿密集的林子，漆黑的瞳孔里，有些许复杂茫然。
一个月前他穿越到了这方世界，一穿越便是倒霉的落到了这片荒无人跡的密林之中。
密林里猛兽繁多，虎豹豺狼环伺，时常在林间走动长吟。
特別是夜间，稍微探个头就能看到无数双发光的眼睛，在暗中窥探。
若不是跑得快的话，他现在估计已经被消化好，成为林间树木的养料了。
好在，天无绝人之路，在逃跑的过程中，楚风发现了立在林子里的这间茅屋。
此处被一棵棵大树环绕，包围在其中，极为的隱秘。
生活在这间茅草屋里，一开始也算是洒脱自在。
毕竟平日里倒是没有野兽进犯，他也能靠著林间的兔子和野鸡饱腹。
不过……
楚风的双眼在眼前这片林间较为宽阔的地带扫动，警惕的打量著左右。
content_en:
Southern Wilderness Realm.
On the edge of the continent, thousands of mountains overlap and surround the entire world.
Like an isolated island, suspended in the world.
Because of this, this world was named the Southern Wilderness Realm.
The world doesn't know if there is a sky beyond the southern wilderness, and no one has ever passed through the mountains surrounded by mountains to go to the world outside the mountains.
For people in the Southern Wilderness Realm, the vast world within the Hundred Thousand Mountains is the only world.
There are five great dynasties standing in the Southern Wilderness Realm, which spans a hundred thousand miles.
These five dynasties jointly rule the Southern Wilderness World and are the sole masters of this world. They have absolute rights of life and death over the creatures in the world.
Like five mountains, hanging firmly above the heads of the world.
Even the people of later generations, no matter how powerful the forces that emerged, have never shaken the rule of the Five Dynasties.
Except for the secular forces such as the five dynasties.
There are many martial arts sects standing in the Southern Wilderness Realm.
Countless martial arts among them are practiced under the rules established by the five dynasties and many sects.
The currently known realms of martial arts cultivators are divided into seven realms from weak to strong: third-rate, second-rate, first-rate acquired, innate, master, and grand master. The levels are strict and difficult to overcome.
Third-rate warriors are the lowest level of warriors in the five dynasties, and they can be regarded as the same low-level existence as ordinary people.
Most of the third-rate martial arts masters can only work as bodyguards or police officers, and other hard-working and driven jobs.
But the Grand Master, a warrior who stands at the pinnacle of martial arts in the Southern Wilderness Territory, is different.
The Grand Master is not only revered by the world, but also by the princes, nobles, and elders of the sect who treat him politely when they meet him. They will invite him into the power at any cost and become a high-ranking guest.
Although they are both cultivators, their status is as different as that of Yunni.
"It is precisely because of this that the martial arts cultivators from the five major dynasties are all trying desperately to squeeze up."
"Alas..."
These contents were read over and over again, and Chu Feng almost felt like vomiting.
There is a dense forest in the north of Li Country, on Jiangnan Road, and outside Dongli City.
The dense forest here is the most famous forest in Dongli City.
The dense forest occupies a huge area and surrounds Dongli City.
There are often ferocious beasts wandering around the outskirts of the dense forest, and ordinary people dare not approach them.
Even the third-rate warriors only dare to wander around the outer layer and dare not go deep into it.
Because of this, this forest has been neglected for more than ten years and has become a kind of forbidden land.
But in the depths of the dense forest where few people visited, a thatched house suddenly stood.
In the thatched house, the young man crossed his legs and looked through the few books in the room.
Chu Feng closed the book, sighed, and walked out of the thatched cottage.
He glanced left and right at the dense green forest, and there was something complicated and confused in his dark pupils.
He traveled to this world a month ago, and as soon as he crossed over, he was unlucky enough to fall into this deserted dense forest.
There are many ferocious beasts in the dense forest, surrounded by tigers, leopards, and wolves, who often walk around and chant in the forest.
Especially at night, if you poke your head slightly, you can see countless pairs of glowing eyes, peering in the dark.
If he hadn't run so fast, he would have been digested by now and become food for the trees in the forest.
Fortunately, there is always a path, and in the process of escaping, Chu Feng discovered this hut standing in the forest.
This place is surrounded by big trees and is extremely private.
Living in this thatched house was considered free and easy at first.
After all, there are no wild beasts to attack on weekdays, and he can also rely on rabbits and pheasants in the forest to satisfy his hunger.
But...
Chu Feng's eyes swept across the relatively wide area of ​​the forest in front of him, looking around vigilantly.
